 About the match
 On this page you can find the Heerenveen vs Feyenoord match lineup for Eredivisie — Round 12 - First Leg, on Sunday 08-11-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. Heerenveen lines up in a 4-2-3-1 led by Willemsen, while Feyenoord sets up in a 4-3-3 led by Valente. Heerenveen is led by head coach Robin Veldman, while Feyenoord is managed by Giovanni van Bronckhorst. The match is played at Abe Lenstra Stadion.
